messages:
Maya (platform): Quick idea — we need a compact policy editor in Console that lets PMs set per-tier routing + fallback variants + a soft-quota grace window. Sketch below.
Kevin (runtime): yes please. current API is too verbose for product to manage.
Sasha (product): can you paste a minimal API sample? helps UX sketch.
Maya (platform): Sure — proposed API (readable):
```
{ "tier": "pro", "region": "eu-west-1", "routes": [ { "model": "gptx-4-32k", "weight": 0.8 }, { "model": "gptx-4-16k-quant", "weight": 0.15 }, { "model": "gptx-3.5-compact", "weight": 0.05 } ], "fallback_policy": { "soft_quota_pct": 0.1, "grace_seconds": 45, "fallback_to": ["gptx-4-16k-quant","gptx-3.5-compact"] } }
```
Liz (product): love the compact shape. UX question: do PMs think in weights or "preferred primary + fallback list"? weights are more flexible but harder to explain.
Sasha (product): we'd expose both: simple toggle for "preferred" + advanced weights editor. Default to human-friendly list.
Kevin (runtime): runtime needs deterministic selection when a variant is overloaded — we should treat soft_quota_pct as a proportion of requests that can be routed off-primary before marking primary throttled. Also need TTL on KV cache entries per-variant.
Ana (sre): telemetry ask — add counters: routed_to_primary, routed_to_variant[name], fallback_trigger_reason (quota|latency|err), and per-tenant windowed rate of fallbacks. We need these for alerting.
Maya (platform): Agreed. Console will show a per-tier graph: primary traffic %, fallback % by model, 95p latency per-model, and a "grace events" heatmap.
Kevin (runtime): small edge-case: what if fallback model is incompatible (diff vocab/format)? need schema validation in API to block incompatible combos.
Liz (product): UX note: warn if model variants have different tokenizers or incompatible function calling signatures. Offer an "auto-compatibility check" button in Console.
Sasha (product): rollout UX — add canary: allow 1% traffic from Enterprise->new-variant for 1 hour, then ramp. Also a "safety cap" per-tenant to avoid cross-tenant noisy neighbor effects.
Maya (platform): We should also support an "override endpoint" for SRE to temporarily force routes for troubleshooting (with audit log and expiration).
DeployBot: deploy queued: routing-service v3.4.2 -> canary -> infra-qa at 15:12 UTC :rocket:
Ana (sre): small operational concern: soft_quota_pct + grace_seconds must be cluster-wide consistent; otherwise tenants will see flapping. How do we ensure config propagation atomicity?
Kevin (runtime): propose: policy documents are versioned and applied via a single commit to control-plane; runtime reads policy at request start and caches for 1s with optional invalidate API. That keeps flapping low.
Maya (platform): API shape change: add policy_id + revision in response and in telemetry events.
Liz (product): can we show the revision in Console and allow rollbacks? yes pretty critical.
Sasha (product): final ask: for free tier default fallback should be more aggressive (lower primary weight) but show expected cost/latency tradeoffs inline so PMs can preview.
Maya (platform): ok action items: (1) Kevin add compatibility validation + policy versioning PR, (2) Ana add telemetry counters + alert rule draft, (3) Sasha/Liz design console mockups for simple vs advanced editor, (4) Maya draft API docs + migration notes. I'll create GH tasks.
Kevin (runtime): I'll open the PR after lunch.
Ana (sre): I'll spin up alert draft and share rule ids.
Liz (product): will start a Figma file and ping design.
Sasha (product): thanks — tagging @here for visibility :eyes: 
Maya (platform): :thumbsup: Thanks team — short sync tomorrow 10:00 to lock scope.
